name: Dumbbell Wrist Extension
cardText:
1
Grab two dumbbells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across your knees.
2
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
cardText:
1
Grip the dumbbell with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
2
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
3
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Row Unilateral
cardText:
1
Brace your off arm against something stable (bench, box). Stagger your stance so your leg on the side of your working arm is back.
2
Try to get your torso to parallel with the ground. That will extend your range of motion.
3
Let your arm hang freely and then pull your elbow back. Imagine you've got a tennis ball in your armpit and squeeze it each rep.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
cardText:
1
Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
2
Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.

name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Curl
cardText:
1
Lay on an incline bench.
2
Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
3
Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.

name: Dumbbell Incline Zottman Curl
cardText:
1
Lay on an incline bench with your palms facing forward.
2
Flex at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps.
3
When you hit the top of the movement, rotate your palms and then lower the dumbbells slowly.

name: Dumbbell Bench Wrist Curl
cardText:
1
Grip the dumbbell with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
2
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
3
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Wrist Curl
cardText:
1
Drape one arm over a bench while holding a dumbbell. Point your palm toward the ceiling.
2
Extend and curl your wrist against resistance.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Supinations Pronations
cardText:
1
Sit by a bench or table and lean your arm on it.
2
Hold a dumbbell/weight/lever on one end.
3
Rotate the wrist so the palm faces down and up in succession.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Chin Ups
cardText:
1
Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you). Use a dip belt and the let the weight hang between your legs.
2
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
3
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Farmer Walk
cardText:
1
Grab a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight down.
2
Walk forward with a straight posture.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Reverse Incline Curl
cardText:
1
Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
2
Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.
3
Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
4
Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Reverse Incline Curl
cardText:
1
Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
2
Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Wrist Curl
cardText:
1
Sit on bench, forearm resting on thigh, palm facing up holding dumbbell.
2
Lower wrist to stretch forearm, keeping forearm flat on thigh.
3
Curl wrist upward, squeezing forearm flexors at the top.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Reverse Curl
cardText:
1
Lay on an incline bench.
2
Grab a dumbbell with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
3
Flex at the elbows until your bicep touches your forearm. Try not to let your elbow flair outward.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Reverse Curl
cardText:
1
Hold dumbbell with palm facing down and arm straight by your side.
2
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, leading with back of hand.
3
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping wrist stable.

name: Dumbbell Zottman Curl
cardText:
1
Hold dumbbells at sides, palms facing forward, elbows tight to body.
2
Curl both dumbbells up, then rotate palms downward at the top.
3
Lower slowly with palms facing the floor, controlling the descent.

name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Curl
cardText:
1
Sit tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing downward.
2
Curl dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping wrists stable and elbows tucked.
3
Lower slowly to full extension, maintaining control throughout.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Reverse Curl
cardText:
1
Sit tall holding one dumbbell at your side with palm facing downward.
2
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, keeping wrist stable and elbow tucked.
3
Lower slowly to full extension while maintaining control.

name: Dumbbell Seated Zottman Curl
cardText:
1
Sit tall holding dumbbells at sides with palms facing forward.
2
Curl dumbbells up, then rotate palms downward at the top.
3
Lower slowly with palms down, controlling the entire descent.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Pendlay Row
cardText:
1
Stand with feet hip-width, hinge forward until torso is nearly parallel to floor.
2
Grab dumbbell from floor with straight arm, keeping back flat and core braced.
3
Pull elbow straight up to ribs, then lower dumbbell fully back to the floor each rep.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
cardText:
1
Hinge at hips with back flat, holding dumbbell under shoulder with arm extended.
2
Pull elbow out and back at a wide angle, targeting rear delt.
3
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Zottman Curl
cardText:
1
Sit tall holding dumbbell at your side with palm facing forward.
2
Curl dumbbell up, then rotate palm downward at the top.
3
Lower slowly with palm down, controlling the entire descent.
